name: Saffire-I
objective: Large-scale flame spread and material flammability in an uncrewed Cygnus cargo vehicle.
materials_note: SIBAL cotton-fiberglass fabric, 41 × 94 cm in Urban Table 2 (Olson Table 1: 40.6 × 94 cm).
apparatus: Fan-driven flow duct inside Cygnus. Urban Table 2 labels it 46 cm; Olson gives a 51 cm full duct height.

name: Saffire-II
objective: Large-scale flame spread and material flammability in an uncrewed Cygnus cargo vehicle.
materials_note: Nine 5 × 30 cm samples including SIBAL, silicone, PMMA and Nomex (Olson Table 1 lists the SIBAL samples as 5 × 29 cm).
apparatus: Fan-driven flow duct inside Cygnus. Urban Table 2 labels it 46 cm; Olson gives a 51 cm full duct height.

name: Saffire-III
objective: Large-scale flame spread and material flammability in an uncrewed Cygnus cargo vehicle.
materials_note: SIBAL cotton-fiberglass fabric, 41 × 94 cm in Urban Table 2 (Olson Table 1: 40.6 × 94 cm).
apparatus: Fan-driven flow duct inside Cygnus. Urban Table 2 labels it 46 cm; Olson gives a 51 cm full duct height. PSI-100 lists 30 cm/s airflow where the paper gives 25.

name: Saffire-IV, -V
objective: Spacecraft-scale flame spread across a range of atmospheres, with fire monitoring and cleanup demonstrations.
materials_note: SIBAL fabric and cotton jersey, 41 × 50 cm. PMMA samples.
apparatus: Flow duct, 30 cm high, inside Cygnus
sensors: Video, flame temperature, radiant heat, oxygen calorimetry, carbon dioxide

name: BASS
objective: Burning and extinction of small solid fuel samples in low-speed forced flow on the ISS.
materials_note: SIBAL fabric 1 and 2 cm wide (Urban Figure 10 legend; Olson Table 1 lists 1.2 and 2.2 cm). Other BASS materials are not indexed here.
apparatus: Microgravity Science Glovebox with the flow duct built for SPICE

name: BASS-II
objective: Burning and extinction of small solid fuel samples in low-speed forced flow on the ISS.
materials_note: Acrylic (PMMA) slabs and rods in opposed flow. The summary report lists 39 published PMMA spread rates from 18 tests; these are not indexed as runs here.
apparatus: Microgravity Science Glovebox with the flow duct built for SPICE

name: SAME and SAME-R
objective: Smoke and aerosol measurements in microgravity to test fire detection.
apparatus: Smoke instruments, one later reused to detect dust in DAFT and DAFT-2

name: FLEX and FLEX-2
objective: Burning and extinction of liquid fuel droplets. FLEX studied suppression by diluting the atmosphere with carbon dioxide and helium.
apparatus: Multi-user Droplet Combustion Apparatus in the Combustion Integrated Rack

name: ACME Burning Rate Emulator
objective: Materials flammability in still atmospheres as a function of material properties, studied with a gaseous burner.
materials_note: Gaseous fuel through a porous burner that emulates a burning material.
apparatus: ACME hardware in the Combustion Integrated Rack

name: ACME Cool Flames Investigation with Gases
objective: Cool flames of gaseous fuels. These were the highest-oxygen microgravity tests.
materials_note: Nitrogen with a flammable gas such as propane in the chamber.
apparatus: ACME hardware with a spherical burner
caution: Up to 85% oxygen flowed from the burner as an oxidizer stream. That is not a cabin atmosphere, so it is not compared with habitat oxygen.
